ShaderNodePreset.Name: AA_Multiband_ColorCorrect_wheel_v12
ShaderNodePreset.Description: Six-band colour corrector: Master plus fixed Low, Low Mid, Mid, High Mid and High luminance bands. Each tab includes Gamma, Gain, Offset, Exposure, Contrast, Saturation and a Colour Wheel. Wheel Hue sets the target hue; Gain sets strength; Mix scales the wheel effect. Use Picker limits a tab by colour; Picker Tol sets range and Picker Soft feathers the selection. Show Matte displays the active selection in white. Optional external Matte limits all corrections: white = full, black = protected, gray = partial. Bypass disables the current tab. Made by Anthony Augusta. AnthonyAugustaCreations@gmail.com

Uniform.Name: master_show_matte
Uniform.Tooltip: Preview this tab’s active selection as a black-and-white matte. White is affected; black is protected.

Uniform.Name: master_bypass
Uniform.Tooltip: Bypass all controls on this tab.

Uniform.Name: master_picker_enable
Uniform.Tooltip: Restrict this tab to the colour chosen with Pick Color. Picker Tol sets the range; Picker Soft feathers the edge.

Uniform.Name: master_picker_color
Uniform.Tooltip: Use the colour control / picker to select the master colour range. This drives the picker matte only when Use Picker is enabled.

Uniform.Name: master_picker_tolerance
Uniform.Tooltip: Colour-picker tolerance. Higher values include a wider range of colours around Pick Color.

Uniform.Name: master_picker_softness
Uniform.Tooltip: Softens/feathers the edge of the colour-picker selection.

Uniform.Name: master_curve_control
Uniform.Tooltip: Adjusts midtone brightness within this tab’s active selection.

Uniform.Name: master_gain
Uniform.Tooltip: Multiplies RGB intensity within this tab’s active selection.

Uniform.Name: master_offset
Uniform.Tooltip: Adds or subtracts a constant RGB value within this tab’s active selection.

Uniform.Name: master_exposure
Uniform.Tooltip: Exposure adjustment in stops within this tab’s active selection.

Uniform.Name: master_contrast
Uniform.Tooltip: Adjusts contrast around a 0.5 pivot within this tab’s active selection.

Uniform.Name: master_saturation
Uniform.Tooltip: Adjusts colour saturation within this tab’s active selection.

Colour Wheel: Hue chooses the target hue, Gain controls how strongly that hue is added, and Mix scales the wheel contribution. The wheel is limited by this tab’s tonal/picker/external matte selection.
Uniform.Name: masterColourWheel
